# Gains: Get Short, Long, and Total Gains

Area overview and notes: [gains.md](../gains.md)

`GET /gains/breakdown` · tenant-scoped token

Get the user's gains broken into long and short term gains/losses and the total.

**Query parameters**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `account_id` | string | No | Your system's unique identifier for the Account. |
| `end_date` | string (date-time) | Yes | ISO-8601 formatted date as a filter end date. |
| `start_date` | string (date-time) | Yes | ISO-8601 formatted date as a filter start date. |

**Headers**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `x-user-id` | string (uuid) | No | The Taxbit UUID of the account. Ignored if account_id is specified. |

**Response 200**: Breakdown of a user's gains

| `long_term.asset` | object | Yes |  |
| `long_term.asset.code` | string | Yes | Asset Code (BTC, ETH, LTC, etc.) |
| `long_term.asset.name` | string | Yes | Asset Full Name. |
| `long_term.asset.symbol` | string | No | Asset Symbol (Like $). |
| `long_term.asset.type` | string | Yes | Asset Type. One of: `Fiat`, `Crypto`, `Precious Metal`. |
| `long_term.asset.uuid` | string (uuid) | Yes | Asset UUID in the Taxbit system. |
